title: Final Design — DK Bond Tracker (implementation-ready consolidation of PRD v2, SRS, feasibility, architecture, atomic functions, pseudocode, test plan and development order)
author: worker-9
purpose: Single implementation-ready consolidation so a fresh Stage-11 executor can build the MVP without reading any prior conversation: pinned source versions, final tech decisions, 37-AF traceability (file + wave + requirements + tests), the UI contract, the 42-requirement acceptance matrix, implementation readiness checklist, honest L1/L2 holds and open points.

architecture_summary.runtime: Python 3.14 in the project .venv; the only other prerequisites are a desktop browser and (for one-time import only) the source XLSM file
architecture_summary.frontend: Flask + Jinja2 server-rendered HTML on every request — no client framework, no JavaScript build, no snapshots cached between requests (ADR-01, ADR-07, ADR-08; D1)
architecture_summary.persistence: SQLite via Python stdlib sqlite3 — one local DB file per user with bonds / payment_ledger / home_plan tables; row-per-payment model, never per-month columns; Till Return, Balance and status are query-derived, never stored (ADR-03, ADR-06; D3)
architecture_summary.import: One-time openpyxl pipeline (data_only double-load) that reads the XLSM read-only, normalizes sheets/headers by keyword, recomputes K/L formula columns, reconciles against a baseline and commits atomically; Excel remains a read-only backup (ADR-02; D2)
architecture_summary.export: UTF-8 RFC-4180 CSV replaces the legacy xlsx export; any displayed dataset is serializable (ADR-04; D4)
architecture_summary.status_engine: Fixed D5 rules — Danger = ANY unpaid past month (not just the previous month); Completed overrides when months paid >= tenure; zero-value counts as unpaid; no scan-window limit, derived on every view (ADR-05; D5)
architecture_summary.testing: pytest unit + integration + e2e with seeded fixture portfolios and Flask test client; 58 TCs bound 94 ways across all 42 requirements
architecture_summary.ci: No CI configured — local gates only (pytest + store-projector --verify + store-gates --all --strict); stated honestly, never implied remote
architecture_summary.constraints: Offline-only, single-user, localhost 127.0.0.1 bind, zero secrets, no accounts, no cloud, no build step (ADR-01, ADR-09, ADR-10; D10)
architecture_summary.quirk_policy: Known Excel/VBA defects (hardcoded month headers, Jan-2031 scan limit, single-month Danger check, On Error Resume Next) are fixed, not reproduced (ADR-09)
architecture_summary.l1_policy: PRD exit figures must be re-baselined by the owner BEFORE L1 acceptance tests can go green; until then TC-26 stays pending_baseline and the import reports computed-vs-baseline side by side, never force-matches (ADR-10)

traceability.name: Void or correct a payment row
Serve dashboard page from live queries
Export current view as UTF-8 CSV
Export full payment ledger as UTF-8 CSV
Check duplicate ISIN across full bond set
Generate payout due dates by cycle
Compute dashboard P&L and ongoing TL

traceability_notes.file_source: AF element mapped to the architecture building_blocks layout path: ledger_repository->src/db.py, status_engine->src/status.py, dashboard_query_module->src/queries.py, route_handlers->src/app.py, xlsx_reader and import_pipeline->src/import_xlsm.py, validators->src/validators.py, csv_exporter->src/export_csv.py, month_grid_renderer->src/templates/
traceability_notes.wave_source: Development_Order waves W0..W7; every depends_on AF lands in an earlier or same wave
traceability_notes.key_tests_rule: Wave test_gates intersected with the AF's fr_refs via Test_Plan test_bindings; where the intersection is empty (AF-02, AF-03, AF-05, AF-06, AF-23, AF-29, AF-30, AF-31) the full wave gate list is used as instructed; AF-08 additionally carries TC-26 because the Development_Order L1 hold names AF-08<->TC-26 explicitly even though TC-26 binds NFR-10
traceability_notes.pseudocode_coverage: Pseudocode_DK_Bond_Tracker_v1 carries exactly one entry per AF (37/37) with 132 edge cases total

pages: Dashboard — portfolio summary counts (Total/Danger/On-going/Completed), amounts (Total Investment, Till Return, Balance), this-month returns, full monthly history with current month highlighted, bonds status overview ordered Danger -> On-going -> Completed, P&L and ongoing TL (Phase 4), reinvestment free-up line, export affordance
Bond month-grid view — Excel-like months-across grid rendered per bond from payment_ledger rows with dynamic month headers, payment cell edit, status cell

Import/launch surface — one documented launch command binds Flask on 127.0.0.1; the one-time XLSM import is a CLI step whose reconciliation report (computed vs baseline, L1 flag when mismatched) is shown to the operator
Home Plan view — 84-month schedule with irregular savings, rate, per-year interest, countdown, remaining interest (Phase 3)
Watch list view — analytics computed on view from extracted inputs, reproducing Excel formulas (Phase 3)
CSV export affordance — every displayed dataset (dashboard tables, month grid, Home Plan, watch list, bond detail) offers UTF-8 CSV download; export matches displayed rows exactly (D4)
ui_decisions.dynamic_month_headers: Month columns derived at render time from each bond's start month + tenure — no hardcoded Sep-2025..Feb-2027 headers, no Jan-2031 limit; a Feb-2031+ bond renders its full grid with D5 status and no dropped months (FR-04, FR-18, FR-19, NFR-9; ADR-09)
ui_decisions.error_surfaces: Flask error handlers render an explicit error page/message for unexpected route exceptions; import failures abort with a named error and never a partial success; unresolvable current month shows an explicit message, never a silent 0; duplicate ISIN flagged across the full bond set; no silent fallback zeros presented as success (FR-21, NFR-6)
ui_decisions.offline_localhost_constraints: Server binds 127.0.0.1 only; zero outbound network in any code path; no accounts, sessions or auth layer; single local SQLite file is the sole persistence artifact; sharing means copying the folder (D1, D10; NFR-1, NFR-2, NFR-13)

implementation_readiness.definition_of_done: All waves W0..W7 green except held acceptances L1/L2; coverage stays 42/42; every AF implemented exactly once in its wave; final regression runs with honest reds only on the two held TCs (or zero reds once L1/L2 settle)
implementation_readiness.no_ci_note: no CI configured - local gates only (honest)
implementation_readiness.wave_order: W0 Foundation (AF-01, AF-02, AF-29, AF-30) -> W1 Import pipeline (AF-03..AF-09, AF-28) -> W2 Ledger + status engine (AF-10..AF-16) -> W3 Dashboard queries + route (AF-17..AF-22) -> W4 Grid UI + launch + payment flow (AF-23..AF-25) -> W5 CSV export (AF-26, AF-27) -> W6 Phase 3 features (AF-31..AF-33) -> W7 Phase 4 features (AF-34..AF-37); SERIES execution, wave N fully green before wave N+1 starts
implementation_readiness.verification_note: Per wave: pytest wave subset locally + store-projector --verify + store-gates --all --strict at each wave close; full local regression after W4 and after W7; remote tier: none
implementation_readiness.test_gates_rule: EXACT Development_Order wave test_gates (copied verbatim); W1 exit excludes held TC-26; W7 exit excludes held TC-40 until L2 settles
